transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

...I don't know, really. I guess the main thing is I just... stopped caring about things. Stuff I used to look forward to. 

My fishing gear has just been sitting untouched out in the garage. Going out to the woodshop just feels like a chore now. Even when my kids try to get me to play chess with them, I'm just... going through the motions. That's about it, I guess.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
...I don't know about sad. I haven't really thought about it like that. Just... like I said, just going through the motions. I'm not really sure.
Do you still enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable?
...No. Not really. Like I was saying before about the fishing and the shop... I just don't get anything out of them anymore. It's just... nothing.
Do you feel much pleasure when you're with your family or friends?
...I mean, like I said a minute ago about my kids. Even with them, it's just... going through the motions. I don't really feel it. I just stopped caring about all of it, I guess.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
...Didn't you just ask me that? I... I don't really know. Like I said, I wouldn't exactly call it sad. It's just... I don't know. Just empty, I guess.
Do you feel any pleasure at all in your daily life?

I... look, I feel like we just went over this. No. I don't. Like I keep saying, I just stopped caring about everything I used to look forward to. 

My fishing gear is just sitting out in the garage untouched. Going out to the woodshop just feels like a chore now. And even when the kids try to get me to play chess or whatever... I'm just going through the motions. There's no pleasure in any of it.
Do you feel hopeless?
...I don't really know. I haven't thought about it like that. I wouldn't say hopeless, exactly. Just... I don't know. Like I keep saying, just empty.
How long have you been feeling this way?

...A while. I guess... maybe a year and seven months? Give or take. 

It started back when... well, my wife started having some health problems. Everything at home just... changed. So, yeah. Since then.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past year and seven months?

...I suppose so. I've had to bring my belt in a couple notches. Wasn't really trying to. 

Just... most days food tastes like cardboard. I usually skip breakfast, and... even if I've been out on a job site all day, I just kind of pick at dinner. I just don't really care about eating.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?

...I wouldn't say I want to hurt myself. Not exactly. But... I don't know. 

I have to drive out to the sites pretty early, before anyone else is really awake. And... sometimes I just catch myself thinking it would be easier if I just didn't make it there. Just... I don't know. Sometimes the thought of just steering off the road... it scares me a bit. Just because it feels a little too close.
Do you find yourself moving more slowly than you used to or feeling restless and unable to sit still?
...I don't really know. I haven't noticed anything like that. I just sort of... get through the day. I don't think I'm moving any slower than usual. And I'm not restless, no.
Do you often feel worthless or guilty about things?

...I suppose. I just... I've been feeling like I'm failing everybody lately. My wife, the kids... the guys on the crew. 

It's just... if anything goes wrong at work, like a cost overrun or some safety issue, I just... I take it pretty hard. It just feels like proof that I'm useless now. Like they'd all be better off if someone else was in charge.
Do you often think about death?

...I think I already said this, but... yeah. 

Like I mentioned before, on those early morning drives to the site... I just think about not making it. Just... steering off the road. It's just... it's a thought that comes up. It scares me sometimes, how close it feels. But... yeah. I guess I do.
Do you feel like you're able to concentrate on things as well as you used to?

...No. Not really. 

I used to... I mean, I used to be able to keep all the schedules and subcontractors straight in my head. No problem. But now... I don't know. I'll just sit there and read the same email three times. Or I'll be in a meeting and just... forget what I was about to say. 

It's hard. Even small decisions... things I used to figure out in five minutes... I just freeze up. I can't seem to focus on it.
Have you experienced any periods of improvement in your mood over the past year and seven months?
...No. Not really. It's just been... pretty much the same.
Have you had any periods where your symptoms were worse than they are now?

...I don't know. Not that I can remember. 

It just... it all feels about the same. Just heavy. I haven't really noticed it being worse.
Would you say your symptoms have interfered with your ability to work or take care of things at home most days, or has it been more like some days are okay and some days are not?

...Most days. Yeah. 

I've... I've started missing things at work. Important stuff. Deadlines, and... safety checks. There was a near-miss on site recently. After that, I couldn't really pretend it was just stress anymore. 

And at home... I'm there. Physically, I mean. But my wife and the kids... they just kind of have to work around me now. They can't really count on me the way they used to.
Would you say that your feelings of emptiness and not caring about things are present every day?

...Yeah. Every day. 

I just... I don't care anymore. About anything, really. The stuff I used to like... it's just pointless now. 

My fishing gear has just been sitting in the garage. Haven't touched it. Going out to the woodshop... it just feels like too much work. Even when the kids ask me to play chess... I sit there, but... I'm just going through the motions. I don't really feel anything.
Would you say your symptoms have been present for most of the day, nearly every day?
...Yeah. Pretty much. Just... all day.
Would you say your symptoms have caused significant distress or impairment in your social, occupational, or other areas of life?

...Yeah. Like I was saying before. It's... it's definitely messing things up. 

With that near-miss at work, the deadlines... and at home, my family just having to deal with me being like this, instead of being able to rely on me. So... yeah. It's a problem.
